votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location
votes.description: The Board ratified the Chair's decision to hold the meeting electronically without an anchor location due to health and safety concerns and the continued closure of the City and County Building to the public.

votes.motion: Accept the three contingencies as completed so the RDA can execute the necessary contracts to move forward with the 650 South Main TRAX Station project, with the third contingency met because the project is fully funded including by commitments from third parties and the RDA's contribution, and request that the RDA prioritize working with adjacent developers to receive contributions to further offset the RDA's contribution
votes.description: The Board accepted the completion of three funding contingencies for the 650 South Main TRAX Station project, allowing the RDA to proceed with executing contracts for the $3 million project while directing staff to seek developer contributions to offset the RDA's financial commitment.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (including reappointment of Mark Isaac to the Redevelopment Advisory Committee for a term ending January 20, 2025)
votes.description: The Board approved the consent agenda, which included the reappointment of Mark Isaac to the Redevelopment Advisory Committee (RAC).
